diagnosed: REAL, recurring breakage: every scout/coverage-critic ESCALATION to the research agent fails at the claude-code-action step with `Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use '*' to allow all bots.` Root cause: escalate-research.js dispatches research-agent.yml via `gh workflow run` using the job's GITHUB_TOKEN, so the dispatched run's actor is `github-actions[bot]`. anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 refuses a bot-initiated run unless the bot is allow-listed, and all three claude-code-action@v1 steps in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml have `allowed_bots: ""` (empty). Confirmed on run 30736265446 (event=workflow_dispatch, tier=deep, ALLOWED_BOTS empty, both the Fable 5 and the Opus 4.8 fallback steps error with the bot-actor message) and 30768139244; matches the pattern of repeated off-cron 'Research agent' failures (07-27..08-02). Scheduled (cron) research runs are unaffected because a `schedule` event's actor is a human (last editor of the workflow), so only the escalation path — a core coverage loop (scout/coverage-critic -> research on high-severity gaps) — is silently defeated.
notes: FIX IS IN A PROTECTED PATH — cannot be authored by this unattended agent. The only correct fix edits .github/workflows/research-agent.yml (a protected automation path). The CI-only protect-automation.js PreToolUse hook BLOCKED the Write ('A human must author changes to these files'), which is the intended invariant (workflow defs are never auto-authored/auto-merged). I did NOT circumvent the hook (e.g. via `gh api` contents PUT); that is exactly the threat the hook defends against. No non-protected fix exists: making the dispatch actor non-bot would instead require a PAT secret plus edits to scout-agent.yml/coverage-critic-agent.yml env (also protected). So no PR was opened.

READY-TO-APPLY PATCH (for a human): in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml, add `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` to the `with:` block of ALL THREE claude-code-action@v1 steps (Research — Opus 4.8 (standard); Research — Fable 5 (deep, preferred); Research — Opus 4.8 (deep fallback)), e.g. right after the `claude_code_oauth_token:` line. Scope it to `github-actions` (our own automation bot) rather than `*` so no third-party bot (e.g. dependabot) can trigger a Claude run. This is a protected-path change and will wait for review; it does not auto-merge.

PROOF OF ROOT CAUSE: `gh run view 30736265446 --log` shows `Research tier: deep`, `ALLOWED_BOTS:` (empty), then `##[error]Action failed with error: Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use '*' to allow all bots.` on BOTH the Fable and Opus steps. escalate-research.js runs `gh workflow run research-agent.yml` from a job whose token is `github.token` (GITHUB_TOKEN), which is why the actor is the bot.
